---

subtitle: "Interactive breakdown of facilities by resident count, state, and ownership"
format:
  html:
    code-tools: true

    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
---


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| output: false

pacman::p_load("here", "tidyverse", "janitor", "ggplot2", "tidyplots", "ggthemes", "hrbrthemes", "gt")

i_am("analysis/facility-size-categories.qmd")



facilities  <- readRDS(here("cms_3070g/cms3070g_allfields.RDS")) |> 
    select ( ccn=provider_ccn,  state_code, facility=name_of_facility  , parent_name,type_of_ownership, nyt_owner_type, survey_date, county,   icfiid_beds, resident_estimate) |> 
arrange ( ccn, survey_date) |> 
group_by ( ccn ) |> 
slice_tail(n=1) |> 
ungroup() |> 
mutate ( State = factor (case_when ( state_code == "NC" ~ "North Carolina" , 
                                            .default = "Rest of Country") 
                    ), 
         Ownership = factor ( nyt_owner_type, levels = c("Investor owned", "Non-profit", "Government" , "Other" ) ) 
) |>
select ( State, Ownership, Residents = resident_estimate) |> 
filter ( Residents > 0)



```
<!-- for sarah: This defines the defaults -->

```{r}
#| label: pass-to-ojs

default_cuts <- c(10L, 50L)

ojs_define(
  facility_data = facilities,
  default_low = default_cuts[[1]],
  default_high = default_cuts[[2]]
)

```

<!-- Extent is the min and max values -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false


data = transpose(facility_data)
residentsExtent = d3.extent(data, d => d.Residents)


```


<!-- Creates the sliders --> 



```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof cut1 = Inputs.range(
  residentsExtent,
  {
    value: default_low,
    step: 1,
    label: "Small / Medium cutoff"
  }
)
```



```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof cut2 = Inputs.range(
  residentsExtent,
  {
    value: default_high,
    step: 1,
    label: "Medium / Large cutoff"
  }
)
```



```{ojs}
//| echo: false
lowCut = Math.min(cut1, cut2)
highCut = Math.max(cut1, cut2)

```


<!-- equivalent of case when statement to assign a new column called Category 
..d means that it is unpacking the object called d. .map loops through every value in data calling it d -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

categoryOrder = ["Small", "Medium", "Large"]

categorized = data.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  Category:
    d.Residents <= lowCut ? "Small" :
    d.Residents <= highCut ? "Medium" :
    "Large"
}))
```



::: {.callout-note}

## You chose..

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

md`**Small:** ≤ ${lowCut} residents &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Medium:** ${lowCut + 1}–${highCut} residents &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Large:** > ${highCut} residents`

```

:::


```{ojs}
//| echo: false


byStateOwnership = {
  const rolled = d3.rollup(
    categorized,
    v => v.length,
    d => d.State,
    d => d.Ownership,
    d => d.Category
  );
  
  return Array.from(rolled, ([State, byOwn]) =>
    Array.from(byOwn, ([Ownership, byCat]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(categoryOrder, cat => byCat.get(cat) ?? 0);
      return categoryOrder.map(cat => ({
        State,
        Ownership,
        Category: cat,
        Count: byCat.get(cat) ?? 0,
        Percentage: (byCat.get(cat) ?? 0) / total * 100
      }));
    }).flat()
  ).flat();
}


```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

stateOwnershipPivot = {
  const pivoted = d3.rollup(
    byStateOwnership,
    v => v[0].Count,
    d => d.State,
    d => d.Ownership,
    d => d.Category
  );
  
  return Array.from(pivoted, ([State, byOwn]) =>
    Array.from(byOwn, ([Ownership, counts]) => {
      const total = d3.sum(categoryOrder, cat => counts.get(cat) ?? 0);
      return {
        State,
        Ownership,
        ...Object.fromEntries(categoryOrder.map(cat => 
          [cat, ((counts.get(cat) ?? 0) / total * 100).toFixed(1) + '%']
        )),
        Total: total
      };
    })
  ).flat().sort((a, b) => a.State.localeCompare(b.State) || b.Total - a.Total);
}

```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stateTotals = {
  const rolled = d3.rollup(
    categorized,
    v => v.length,
    d => d.State,
    d => d.Category
  );
  
  const stateOrder = ["North Carolina", "Rest of Country"];
  
  return stateOrder.map(state => {
    const counts = rolled.get(state);
    return {
      State: state,
      ...Object.fromEntries(categoryOrder.map(cat => [cat, counts?.get(cat) ?? 0])),
      Total: d3.sum(categoryOrder, cat => counts?.get(cat) ?? 0)
    };
  });
}

```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

Inputs.table(stateTotals, {
  columns: ["State", ...categoryOrder, "Total"],
  header: {
    State: "State",
    Small: "Small",
    Medium: "Medium",
    Large: "Large",
    Total: "Total"
  }
})


```

::: {style="margin-top:2em;"}


```{ojs}
//| echo: false

Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 100,
  marginBottom: 60,
  x: {label: null, domain: categoryOrder},
  y: {label: null},
  fy: {label: null},
  fx: {label: null},
  color: {type: "linear", scheme: "blues", legend: true, label: "Percentage"},
  marks: [
    Plot.cell(byStateOwnership, {
      x: "Category", 
      y: "Ownership", 
      fx: "State",
      fill: "Percentage"
    }),
    Plot.text(byStateOwnership, {
      x: "Category",
      y: "Ownership",
      fx: "State",
      text: "Count",
      fill: d => d.Percentage > d3.max(byStateOwnership, e => e.Percentage) / 2 ? "white" : "black"
    })
  ]
})

```
